## Tag 01B3, a lemma

[Tag 01B3](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01B3) in the Stacks Project.

**`Stacks.SheafOfModules.modulePullback_nonempty_localGeneratorsData`**, a lemma in StacksFrontier (drafted, not yet reviewed), declared in [StacksFrontier/Topology/Sheaves/Modules/Generators/LocallyGeneratedPullback.lean, line 44](https://github.com/AxiomMath/Stacks/blob/c496df0d9beea9deaeabcea8492605f9a0a2313b/StacksFrontier/Topology/Sheaves/Modules/Generators/LocallyGeneratedPullback.lean#L44).

> If a sheaf of modules `G` on `Y` is locally generated by sections, then so is its pullback
> `f^* G` along a morphism of ringed spaces `f : X ⟶ Y`.

```lean
lemma modulePullback_nonempty_localGeneratorsData
    {X Y : RingedSpace.{u, u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (G : _root_.SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing Y))
    (hG : Nonempty G.LocalGeneratorsData) :
    Nonempty ((modulePullback f).obj G).LocalGeneratorsData.{u}
```
